d:
Hey all, RFab.ai here. This is our second go at Loving the Alien. The first version was black-and-white and a lot shorter. We learned a lot from it, so we started over from scratch.

What's new: full colour in a 90s OVA look, a longer story (23 pages) with Harker and his security team, a chase and an escape. At the end there's a bonus section: 15 animated loops and the model sheets.

The art comes out of RFab.ai's video and image tools, and the dialogue was written with our narrative engine, the same one behind the stories on the site. If you want to make your own, it's all at https://rfab.ai

Tell us what works and what doesn't. We're going to keep making these, and your comments decide what the next one looks like.
